_about: The quest camps upstream archived as post-legacy spawns that the period's walkthroughs describe, copied back once per world by deploy/bin/quest_camps.py (owner's choice 2026-10-12; research dillus-guards-2026-10-12 on the owner's machine). Each camp: key (its marker quest-camp:<key> in fork_world_fixes), name (for the start log), names (the rows' names, compared without case), ids (Mob_IDs in offline_classic165_removed_mobs), why (the period source).

camps.name: Delfina's camp
camps.why: Level 43 "Lord of Deceit": Rhodri sends the player to "infiltrate a camp of Tylwyth Teg elves. There is one among them named Delfina" (Allakhazam cquest 363, 2002-09-18); "there is a small campfire, with some Teg Rangers...she is by the fire, linked to 2 rangers" (Allakhazam Pennine bestiary forum, posted 2002-08-08). Upstream archived the 22 rangers within 1250 units of her as post-legacy and left her alone. mob_fixes.json moves the two nearest beside her.

camps.name: the isolationist camp
camps.why: Level 45 "Lord of Deceit": "The courier is next to the tent and he is linked to the two by the fire. When I did this it was a female wizard and a male armsman." (WarCry 645, capture 2002-06-03); the camp "at about loc [38k, 53k]" (2004-04-09) and "I found the Isolationist tent at roughly 35K, 56K" (Allakhazam q376, 2004-03-30), south-east of Caer Berkstead. These are the 39 archived rows of that camp (Pennine loc 35313-39883, 53015-58065). mob_fixes.json moves the courier beside the armsman by the tent.

camps.name: the Ellyll Seer's village
camps.why: Level 48 "Lord of Deceit": the seer in his hut in an Ellyll village of the Pennine Mountains, "Seers BAF, be prepared" (2002); Prima's Pennine key gives the Ellyll villages "Quantity 20-30". Upstream archived the 30 guards and villagers within 1500 units of the seer, leaving one villager and five guards.

camps.name: Lieutenant Grimarth
camps.why: Level 20/25: the renegades' officer at Sir Dillus's tower in Llyn Barfog, "Lieutenant Grimarth ... Minimum Level : 21 Maximum Level : 21" (Allakhazam cmob 6396, entry 2003-04-02); "Lt. grimarth and two guards will make the rounds coming down into the valley" (2003-01-02). He stands where upstream's row had him: no period route for his patrol survives.
